verdicts.opus: D best answered the actual question with traced data. B reached the same answer from the same data but charted only the promising share and left the pessimism side thin. C has stronger traceability and drill-down, but its unsupported definition of ‘contested’ and unresolved corpus-count mismatch weaken its conclusion; B is a transparent memory-based synthesis, while D provides no substantive answer.
